phase: Phase 18: Tactical Convoy Geofencing, Autonomous Power Governor & Multi-Node Stress Benchmark Suite

stories.title: Pure KMP Convoy Geofencing, Hazard Waypoint Radar Alarms & Convoy Split Engine
stories.description: Implement pure KMP ConvoyGeofenceEngine.kt and ConvoyGeofenceModels.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/telemetry/. Provides distance tether monitoring (warn at >300m, breach at >600m from lead rider), waypoint proximity radar detection (entering hazard or mountain pass radius), convoy cluster bifurcation/split detection, and automatic control alarm emission with zero Java or C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or external map SDK dependencies (Rules 2 & 3)
Calculates Great-Circle Haversine tether distances and evaluates warning/breach thresholds
Triggers obstacle hazard proximity alerts when within configured proximity threshold (e.g. 100m)
Detects convoy partition into bifurcated rider clusters and emits split warnings
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Smart Battery Duty-Cycle Governor & Motion-Aware Power Mode
stories.description: Implement pure KMP BatteryGovernor.kt and PowerStateModels.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/power/. Manages dynamic radio power policies (NORMAL, CONSERVATIVE, EXTREME_SURVIVAL, REST_STOP_SLEEP) evaluating battery percentage, motion stillness duration, and link margins. Immediately overrides power-saving upon emergency SOS preemption.
acceptanceCriteria: Scales BLE radio duty cycles dynamically based on battery level (<30% conservative, <15% survival)
Detects motion stillness >10 min and shifts to rest-stop power saving, waking on motion or PTT
Unconditionally restores full power upon Emergency SOS or priority preemption
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Hardware Bridge Wiring & Multiplatform Presentation HUD Integration
stories.description: Wire ConvoyGeofenceEngine and BatteryGovernor into Koin DI (AppModule.kt), IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers. Integrate geofence warning rings, hazard proximity banners, and power governor indicators across Compose Multiplatform (HomeScreen.kt, ProximityRadarView.kt) and 100% Native iOS SwiftUI (ContentView.swift) respecting Rule 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Hardware bridges and IntercomBridge expose reactive flows and CancellationHandle observers (Rule 1)
Compose Multiplatform displays geofence breach banner and power governor status indicator
Native iOS SwiftUI renders tether radius warning ring and battery governor indicator (100% native SwiftUI)
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets

stories.title: 16-Node Concurrent Convoy Stress Simulation Harness & Archify Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement ConvoyStressSimulationHarness.kt simulating 16 virtual riders exchanging voice ADPCM packets, OTA GPX route chunks, geofence alarms, and battery duty cycling over lossy multi-hop RF mesh. Benchmark latency, throughput, and memory bounds. Update Archify architecture diagram specification and generate showcase HTML.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 16 concurrent convoy nodes with RF loss, out-of-order packets, and multi-hop forwarding
Verifies system memory stability (<80MB resident RAM) and zero coroutine leaks under high stress
Archify architecture diagram updated with Sprint 18, 19, and 20 subsystems and delivered with 0 errors
Full test pass and clean release readiness sign-off
